method: Fresh sequential processes per host, three alternating compiled samples per variant and one reference sample per source. Controlled load hooks disable vector modular admission and/or restore exact-size scratch. Parse+execute timed after imports and interpreter construction; whole-process peak RSS. Other-demo controls have two samples per setting. Shared Mac has other load.
notes: Scratch allocation diagnostics cover pool buffer acquisition only, not widening/COW/input snapshots/native arrays or retained bytes.
Real modular vector fallback remains; real multiplication can coexist with integer modular vector stages.
No precision or copy-admission threshold changed.
Intel Euler 213 has one slow exact-pool timing; that workload uses no vector scratch, so no pool-related speedup is inferred.
